peak_density.label: Peak density
peak_density.formula: max over time of Gaussian-smoothed 1 m grid counts / walkable area

hotspots.label: Hotspots
hotspots.formula: connected cells above the warning threshold

exit_area_density.label: Density in front of exits
exit_area_density.formula: PedPy classic density in a 2 m band

crowd_pressure.label: Crowd pressure
crowd_pressure.formula: local density × local velocity variance (Gaussian R = 1 m, 1 s windows); turbulent above 0.02/s² at ≥ warning density (Helbing et al. 2007)

level_of_service.label: Level of service
level_of_service.formula: Fruin (1971) walkway bands A–F by area per person
